title: Falsification tests of TMD-relative ribosome profiles identify topology-associated compartmental differences
description: Code, frozen processed inputs, source data and deterministic reproduction workflow supporting the NARGAB Standard Paper revision. The package preserves the negative prespecified +75-nt result and treats topology-by-compartment and region-composite results as post-reveal observational sensitivity analyses. This is a mixed-license distribution; component licenses and source-data terms remain distinct, as detailed in the rights notes.
